# Material Design 2 layer (plan 4.4–4.8). Tokens are plain C; the rest is
# LVGL. Assets are generated by tools/assets/ (fonts, baked shadows).
file(GLOB MD_ASSETS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/assets/fonts/*.c" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/assets/shadows/*.c")
idf_component_register(
    SRCS "md_tokens.c" "md_theme.c" "md_text.c" "md_ripple.c" "md_shadow.c" "md_widgets.c" "md_gate.c" ${MD_ASSETS}
    INCLUDE_DIRS "include"
    PRIV_INCLUDE_DIRS "."
    REQUIRES lvgl__lvgl
)
